course_name_original: Mécanique des Milieux Continus et Résistance des matériaux
course_name_en: Continuum Mechanics and Strength of Materials

learning_outcomes.text: Dimension simple structures (long beam theory) under elementary loads: normal force, bending, torsion.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, stresses, deformations. Stress/deformation relationships, Continuum Mechanics exercises.
Torsion center (flexural-torsional coupling of open sections).
Introduction to the Finite Element Method for beams (analytical exercises and ABAQUS simulations).
Comparison of profiles in bending - deviated bending.
Strain gauges, curved beam, beam buckling, cylindrical pressure vessel.
assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a collective evaluation (EVC 1) with a coefficient of 0.4 and an individual evaluation (EVI 1) with a coefficient of 0.6. The assessment also includes two written assignments, practical work, and digital practical work using ABAQUS.
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
